  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">
   If an emerging growth company, indicate by check mark if the Registrant has elected not to use the extended transition period for complying with any new or revised financial accounting standards provided pursuant to Section 13(a) of the Exchange Act.<span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">&#160; &#9744;</span>&#160;
  </div><div>


  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">&#160;</div><hr style="border-width: 1px medium 3px; border-style: solid none; border-color: black currentcolor; height: 2px; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;"/><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">1</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"/></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: -36pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 36pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 72pt; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">
     <span style="font-weight: bold;">Item 8.01</span>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">
     <span style="font-weight: bold;">Other Events.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>

  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">&#160;</div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">On November 9, 2026, Apple Inc. (&#8220;Apple&#8221;) consummated the issuance and sale of $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its Floating Rate Notes due 2028 (the &#8220;2028 Floating Rate Notes&#8221;), $750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its Floating Rate Notes due 2029 (the &#8220;2029 Floating Rate Notes&#8221;), $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.650% Notes due 2028 (the &#8220;2028 Fixed Rate Notes&#8221;), $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.750% Notes due 2029 (the &#8220;2029 Fixed Rate Notes&#8221;), $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.900% Notes due 2031 (the &#8220;2031 Fixed Rate Notes&#8221;), $1,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.100% Notes due 2033 (the &#8220;2033 Fixed Rate Notes&#8221;) and $2,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.350% Notes due 2036 (the &#8220;2036 Fixed Rate Notes&#8221; and, together with the 2028 Floating Rate Notes, the 2029 Floating Rate Notes, the 2028 Fixed Rate Notes, the 2029 Fixed Rate Notes, the 2031 Fixed Rate Notes and the 2033 Fixed Rate Notes, the &#8220;Notes&#8221;), pursuant to an underwriting agreement (the &#8220;Underwriting Agreement&#8221;) dated November 5, 2026 among Apple and Goldman Sachs &amp; Co. LLC, BofA Securities, Inc., Deutsche Bank Securities Inc. and J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, as representatives of the several underwriters named therein.
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">
   The Notes are being issued pursuant to an indenture, dated as of November 1, 2024 (the &#8220;Indenture&#8221;), between Apple and The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A., as trustee, together with the officer&#8217;s certificate, dated November 9, 2026 (the &#8220;Officer&#8217;s Certificate&#8221;), issued pursuant to the Indenture establishing the terms of each series of Notes.
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">
   The Notes are being issued pursuant to Apple&#8217;s Registration Statement on Form S-3 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission and dated November 1, 2024 (Reg. No. 333-282937) (the &#8220;Registration Statement&#8221;).
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">
   Interest on the 2028 Floating Rate Notes and the 2029 Floating Rate Notes will be paid quarterly in arrears on February 9, May 9, August 9 and November 9 of each year, beginning on February 9, 2027. Interest on the 2028 Fixed Rate Notes, the 2029 Fixed Rate Notes, the 2031 Fixed Rate Notes, the 2033 Fixed Rate Notes, and the 2036 Fixed Rate Notes will be paid semi-annually in arrears on May 9 and November 9 of each year, beginning on May 9, 2027.
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">
   The 2028 Floating Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2028. The 2029 Floating Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2029. The 2028 Fixed Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2028. The 2029 Fixed Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2029. The 2031 Fixed Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2031. The 2033 Fixed Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2033. The 2036 Fixed Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2036.
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">
   The Notes will be Apple&#8217;s senior unsecured obligations and will rank equally with Apple&#8217;s other unsecured and unsubordinated debt from time to time outstanding.
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">
   The foregoing description of the Notes and related agreements is qualified in its entirety by the terms of the Underwriting Agreement, the Indenture and the Officer&#8217;s Certificate (including the forms of the Notes). Apple is furnishing the Underwriting Agreement and the Officer&#8217;s Certificate (including the forms of the Notes) attached hereto as Exhibits 1.1 and 4.1 through 4.8, respectively, and they are incorporated herein by reference. The Indenture is filed as Exhibit 4.1 to the Registration Statement. An opinion regarding the legality of the Notes is filed as Exhibit 5.1, and is incorporated by reference into the Registration Statement; and a consent relating to the incorporation of such opinion is incorporated by reference into the Registration Statement and is filed as Exhibit 23.1 by reference to its inclusion within Exhibit 5.1.
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -36pt; padding-left: 36pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 72pt; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">
     <span style="font-weight: bold;">Item 9.01</span>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;">
     <span style="font-weight: bold;">Financial Statements and Exhibits.</span>

  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">19</div>

   <font>(REVERSE OF NOTE)</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: center;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: center;">
   <font>APPLE INC.</font>
  </div>

  <div style="text-align: center;">
   <font>Floating Rate Note due 2028</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: center;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>1.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Interest</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Apple Inc. (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Issuer</font><font>&#x201d;) promises to pay interest on the principal amount of this Note at a floating rate per annum, reset quarterly on each Floating Rate Interest Payment Date, equal to Compounded SOFR plus 0.33%, as described below; provided, that in no event will the interest on this Note be less than zero. Cash interest on the Notes will accrue from November 9, 2026 or the most recent Floating Rate Interest Payment Date to which interest has been paid. Interest on this Note will be paid to, but excluding, the relevant Floating Rate Interest Payment Date. The Issuer will pay interest quarterly in arrears on each Floating Rate Interest Payment Date, commencing February 9, 2027, to Holders of record at the close of business on the immediately preceding Interest Record Date. If February 9, May 9, August 9 or November 9 of any year is not a Business Day then the next succeeding Business Day will be the applicable Floating Rate Interest Payment Date and interest on the Notes will be paid on such next succeeding Business Day (unless such next succeeding Business Day falls in the succeeding calendar month, in which case the applicable Floating Rate Interest Payment Date will be the Business Day immediately preceding such February 9, May 9, August 9 or November 9, and interest on the Notes will be paid on such immediately preceding Business Day). If the maturity date of the Notes is not a Business Day, the payment of principal of, and interest on, the Notes will be made on the next succeeding Business Day and no interest will accrue for the period from and after such maturity date.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>2.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Interest Rate Determination and Interest Calculation.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">initial interest period</font><font>&#x201d; means the period from and including the settlement date of the Notes to, but excluding, the first Floating Rate Interest Payment Date. Thereafter, each &#x201c;interest period&#x201d; means the period from and including a Floating Rate Interest Payment Date to, but excluding, the immediately succeeding Floating Rate Interest Payment Date (such succeeding Floating Rate Interest Payment Date, the &#x201c;Latter Floating Rate Interest Payment Date&#x201d;); provided that the final interest period for the Notes will be the period from and including the Floating Rate Interest Payment Date immediately preceding the maturity date of the Notes to, but excluding, the maturity date. Interest on the Notes will be computed on the basis of the actual number of days elapsed over a 360-day year.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The interest rate for the initial interest period will be Compounded SOFR determined on February 5, 2027, plus 0.33%. Thereafter, the interest rate for any interest period will be Compounded SOFR, as determined on the applicable date that is the second U.S. Government Securities Business Day preceding such Floating Rate Interest Payment Date (the &#x201c;Interest Determination Date&#x201d;), plus a margin of 0.33%.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">20</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A., or its successor appointed by the Issuer, will act as calculation agent (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Calculation Agent</font><font>&#x201d;). The Issuer may change the Calculation Agent with respect to the Notes at any time without notice to the Holders. The interest rate and amount of interest to be paid on the Notes for each interest period will be determined by the Calculation Agent. All determinations made by the Calculation Agent shall, in the absence of manifest error, be conclusive for all purposes and binding on the Issuer and the Holders. So long as Compounded SOFR is required to be determined with respect to the Notes, there will at all times be a Calculation Agent. In the event that any then-acting Calculation Agent shall be unable or unwilling to act, or that such Calculation Agent shall fail to duly establish Compounded SOFR for any interest period, or that the Issuer proposes to remove such Calculation Agent, the Issuer will appoint another Calculation Agent.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The amount of interest accrued and payable on the Notes for each interest period will be equal to the product of (i) the outstanding principal amount of the Notes multiplied by (ii) the product of (a) the interest rate for the relevant interest period multiplied by (b) the quotient of the actual number of calendar days in such interest period divided by 360.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>As used herein the following terms have the meanings assigned to them:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Compounded SOFR&#x201d; means, with respect to any interest period, the rate computed in accordance with the following formula set forth below (and the resulting percentage will be rounded, if necessary, to the nearest one hundred-thousandth of a percentage point (e.g., 9.753973% (or .09753973) being rounded down to 9.75397% (or .0975397) and 9.753978% (or .09753978) being rounded up to 9.75398% (or .0975398)):</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: center;">
   <img src="image3.jpg" style="width: 171.02pt; height: 40.51pt;">
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: center;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">where:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Start</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201d; is the SOFR Index value for the day that is two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the first date of the relevant interest period, which for the initial interest period shall be November 5, 2026 (which is two U.S. Government Securities Business Days before the scheduled settlement date of the issuance of the Notes);</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">End</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201d; is the SOFR Index value for the day that is two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the Latter Floating Rate Interest Payment Date relating to such interest </font><font>period; </font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">and</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;d</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">c</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201d; is the actual number of calendar days from (and including) SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Start</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> to (but excluding) SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">End</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> (the actual number of calendar days in the applicable Observation Period).</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">For purposes of determining Compounded SOFR, &#x201c;SOFR Index&#x201d; means, with respect to any U.S. Government Securities Business Day:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">21</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: -18pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 36pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 18.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(1)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">the SOFR Index value as published by the New York Federal Reserve as such index appears on the New York Federal Reserve&#x2019;s Website at 3:00 p.m. (New York time) on such U.S. Government Securities Business Day (the &#x201c;SOFR Determination Time&#x201d;); </font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: italic;">provided</font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> that:</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: -18pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 36pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 18.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(2)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">if a SOFR Index value does not so appear as specified in clause (1) above at the SOFR Determination Time, then:</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: -18pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 54pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 18.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(a)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">if a Benchmark Transition Event and its related Benchmark Replacement Date (each as defined below) have not occurred with respect to SOFR, then Compounded SOFR shall be the rate determined pursuant to the &#x201c;SOFR Index Unavailable&#x201d; provisions described below; or</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 54pt; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: -18pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 54pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 18.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(b)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">if a Benchmark Transition Event and its related Benchmark Replacement Date have occurred with respect to SOFR, then Compounded SOFR shall be the rate determined pursuant to the &#x201c;Effect of a Benchmark Transition Event&#x201d; provisions described below.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 54pt; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;New York Federal Reserve&#x201d; means the Federal Reserve Bank of New York (or a successor administrator of the Secured Overnight Financing Rate).</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;New York Federal Reserve&#x2019;s Website&#x201d; means the website of the New York Federal Reserve, currently at http://www.newyorkfed.org, or any successor source.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Observation Period&#x201d; means, in respect of each interest period, the period from and including two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the first date of such relevant interest period to but excluding two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the Latter Floating Rate Interest Payment Date for such interest </font><font>period;</font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> provided that the first Observation Period shall be the period from and including two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the settlement date of the Notes to, but excluding, the two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the first Floating Rate Interest Payment Date.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Secured Overnight Financing Rate&#x201d; or &#x201c;SOFR&#x201d; means the daily secured overnight financing rate as provided by the New York Federal Reserve on the New York Federal Reserve&#x2019;s Website.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;U.S. Government Securities Business Day&#x201d; means any day except for a Saturday, Sunday or a day on which the Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association recommends that the fixed income departments of its members be closed for the entire day for purposes of trading in U.S. government securities.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>3.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>SOFR Index Unavailable.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">If a SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Start</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> or SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">End</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> is not published on the associated Interest Determination Date and a Benchmark Transition Event and its related Benchmark Replacement Date have not occurred with respect to the Secured Overnight Financing Rate, &#x201c;Compounded SOFR&#x201d; means, for the applicable interest period for which such index is not available, the rate of return on a daily compounded interest investment calculated in accordance with the formula for SOFR Averages, and definitions required for such formula, published on the New York Federal Reserve&#x2019;s Website at https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/treasury-repo-reference-rates-information. For the purposes of this provision, references in the SOFR Averages compounding formula and related definitions to &#x201c;calculation period&#x201d; shall be replaced with &#x201c;Observation Period&#x201d; and the words &#x201c;that is, 30-, 90-, or 180- calendar days&#x201d; shall be removed. If the daily Secured Overnight Financing Rate (&#x201c;SOFRi&#x201d;) does not so appear for any day &#x201c;i&#x201d; in the Observation Period, SOFRi for such day &#x201c;i&#x201d; shall be SOFR published in respect of the first preceding U.S. Government Securities Business Day for which the Secured Overnight Financing Rate was published on the New York Federal Reserve&#x2019;s Website.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">22</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>4.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Effect of a Benchmark Transition Event.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>If the Issuer </font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">or its designee determines on or prior to the relevant Reference Time that a Benchmark Transition Event and its related Benchmark Replacement Date have occurred with respect to the then-current Benchmark, the Benchmark Replacement will replace the then-current Benchmark for all purposes relating to the Notes in respect of all determinations on such date and for all determinations on all subsequent dates. In connection with the implementation of a Benchmark Replacement, the Issuer or its designee will have the right to make Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes from time to time. Any determination, decision or election that may be made by the Issuer or its designee pursuant to this section, including a determination with respect to a tenor, rate or adjustment or of the occurrence or non-occurrence of an event, circumstance or date and any decision to take or refrain from taking any action or any selection:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(1) will be conclusive and binding absent manifest error;</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(2) if made by the Issuer, will be made in its sole discretion;</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(3) if made by the Issuer&#x2019;s designee, will be made after consultation with the Issuer, and such designee will not make any such determination, decision or election to which the Issuer objects; and</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(4) notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the documentation relating to the Notes, shall become effective without consent from the Holders or any other party.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">As used herein the following terms have the meanings assigned to them:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Benchmark&#x201d; means, initially, Compounded SOFR, as such term is defined above; </font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: italic;">provided</font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> that if the Issuer or its designee determines on or prior to the Reference Time that a Benchmark Transition Event and its related Benchmark Replacement Date have occurred with respect to Compounded SOFR (or the published daily SOFR Index used in the calculation thereof) or the then-current Benchmark, then &#x201c;Benchmark&#x201d; means the applicable Benchmark Replacement.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Benchmark Replacement&#x201d; means the first alternative set forth in the order below that can be determined by the Issuer or its designee as of the Benchmark Replacement Date:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(1) the sum of (a) the alternate rate of interest that has been selected or recommended by the Relevant Governmental Body as the replacement for the then-current Benchmark and (b) the Benchmark Replacement Adjustment;</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">23</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(2) the sum of (a) the ISDA Fallback Rate and (b) the Benchmark Replacement Adjustment; or</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(3) the sum of (a) the alternate rate of interest that has been selected by the Issuer or its designee as the replacement for the then-current Benchmark giving due consideration to any industry-accepted rate of interest as a replacement for the then-current Benchmark for U.S. dollar-denominated floating rate notes at such time and (b) the Benchmark Replacement Adjustment.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Benchmark Replacement Adjustment&#x201d; means the first alternative set forth in the order below that can be determined by the Issuer or its designee as of the Benchmark Replacement Date:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(1) the spread adjustment, or method for calculating or determining such spread adjustment (which may be a positive or negative value or zero), that has been selected or recommended by the Relevant Governmental Body for the applicable Unadjusted Benchmark Replacement;</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(2) if the applicable Unadjusted Benchmark Replacement is equivalent to the ISDA Fallback Rate, the ISDA Fallback Adjustment; or</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(3) the spread adjustment (which may be a positive or negative value or zero) that has been selected by the Issuer or its designee giving due consideration to any industry-accepted spread adjustment, or method for calculating or determining such spread adjustment, for the replacement of the then-current Benchmark with the applicable Unadjusted Benchmark Replacement for U.S. dollar-denominated floating rate notes at such time.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes&#x201d; means, with respect to any Benchmark Replacement, any technical, administrative or operational changes (including changes to the definitions or interpretations of interest period, the timing and frequency of determining rates and making payments of interest, the rounding of amounts or tenors, and other administrative matters) that the Issuer or its designee decides may be appropriate to reflect the adoption of such Benchmark Replacement in a manner substantially consistent with market practice (or, if the Issuer or its designee decides that adoption of any portion of such market practice is not administratively feasible or if the Issuer or its designee determines that no market practice for use of the Benchmark Replacement exists, in such other manner as the Issuer or its designee determines is reasonably practicable).</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Benchmark Replacement Date&#x201d; means the earliest to occur of the following events with respect to the then-current Benchmark (including the daily published component used in the calculation thereof):</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(1) in the case of clause (1) or (2) of the definition of &#x201c;Benchmark Transition Event,&#x201d; the later of (a) the date of the public statement or publication of information referenced therein and (b) the date on which the administrator of the Benchmark permanently or indefinitely ceases to provide the Benchmark (or such component); or</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(2) in the case of clause (3) of the definition of &#x201c;Benchmark Transition Event,&#x201d; the date of the public statement or publication of information referenced therein.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">24</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">For the avoidance of doubt, if the event that gives rise to the Benchmark Replacement Date occurs on the same day as, but earlier than, the Reference Time in respect of any determination, the Benchmark Replacement Date will be deemed to have occurred prior to the Reference Time for such determination. For the avoidance of doubt, for purposes of the definitions of Benchmark Replacement Date and Benchmark Transition Event, references to Benchmark also include any reference rate underlying such Benchmark.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Benchmark Transition Event&#x201d; means the occurrence of one or more of the following events with respect to the then-current Benchmark (including the daily published component used in the calculation thereof):</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(1) a public statement or publication of information by or on behalf of the administrator of the Benchmark (or such component) announcing that such administrator has ceased or will cease to provide the Benchmark (or such component), permanently or indefinitely; provided that, at the time of such statement or publication, there is no successor administrator that will continue to provide the Benchmark (or such component);</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(2) a public statement or publication of information by the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of the Benchmark (or such component), the central bank for the currency of the Benchmark (or such component), an insolvency official with jurisdiction over the administrator for the Benchmark (or such component), a resolution authority with jurisdiction over the administrator for the Benchmark (or such component) or a court or an entity with similar insolvency or resolution authority over the administrator for the Benchmark, which states that the administrator of the Benchmark (or such component) has ceased or will cease to provide the Benchmark (or such component) permanently or indefinitely; provided that, at the time of such statement or publication, there is no successor administrator that will continue to provide the Benchmark (or such component); or</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(3) a public statement or publication of information by the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of the Benchmark announcing that the Benchmark is no longer representative.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;ISDA Definitions&#x201d; means the 2006 ISDA Definitions published by the International Swaps and Derivatives Association, Inc. or any successor thereto, as amended or supplemented from time to time, or any successor definitional booklet for interest rate derivatives published from time to time.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;ISDA Fallback Adjustment&#x201d; means the spread adjustment (which may be a positive or negative value or zero) that would apply for derivatives transactions referencing the ISDA Definitions to be determined upon the occurrence of an index cessation event with respect to the Benchmark.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;ISDA Fallback Rate&#x201d; means the rate that would apply for derivatives transactions referencing the ISDA Definitions to be effective upon the occurrence of an index cessation date with respect to the Benchmark for the applicable tenor excluding the applicable ISDA Fallback Adjustment.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Reference Time&#x201d; with respect to any determination of the Benchmark means (1) if the Benchmark is Compounded SOFR, the SOFR Determination Time, and (2) if the Benchmark is not Compounded SOFR, the time determined by the Issuer or its designee after giving effect to the Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">25</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Relevant Governmental Body&#x201d; means the Federal Reserve Board and/or the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, or a committee officially endorsed or convened by the Federal Reserve Board and/or the Federal Reserve Bank of New York or any successor thereto.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Unadjusted Benchmark Replacement&#x201d; means the Benchmark Replacement excluding the Benchmark Replacement Adjustment.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">None of the Trustee (as hereinafter defined), the Paying Agent or the Calculation Agent shall be under any obligation (i) to monitor, determine or verify the unavailability or cessation of SOFR or the SOFR Index (or any other Benchmark), or whether or when there has occurred, or to give notice to any other transaction party of the occurrence of, any Benchmark Transition Event or related Benchmark Replacement Date, (ii) to select, determine or designate any Benchmark Replacement, or other successor or replacement benchmark index, or whether any conditions to the designation of such a rate or index have been satisfied, (iii) to select, determine or designate any Benchmark Replacement Adjustment, or other modifier to any replacement or successor index, or (iv) to determine whether or what Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes are necessary or advisable, if any, in connection with any of the foregoing, including, but not limited to, adjustments as to any alternative spread thereon, the </font><font>Business Day</font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> convention, interest determination dates or any other relevant methodology applicable to such substitute or successor benchmark. In connection with the foregoing, each of the Trustee, the Paying Agent or the Calculation Agent shall be entitled to conclusively rely on any determinations made by the Issuer or its designee without independent investigation, and none will have any liability for actions taken at the Issuer&#x2019;s direction in connection therewith. None of the Trustee, the Paying Agent or the Calculation Agent shall be liable for any inability, failure or delay on its part to perform any of its duties set forth in the Indenture or this Note as a result of the unavailability of SOFR, the SOFR </font><font>Index</font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> or other applicable Benchmark Replacement, including as a result of any failure, inability, delay, error or inaccuracy on the part of any other transaction party in providing any direction, instruction, notice or information required or contemplated by the terms of the Indenture or this Note and reasonably required for the performance of such duties. None of the Trustee, the Paying Agent or the Calculation Agent shall be responsible or liable for the Issuer&#x2019;s actions or omissions or for those of its designee, or for any failure or delay in the performance by the Issuer or its designee, nor shall any of the Trustee, Paying Agent or Calculation Agent be under any obligation to oversee or monitor the Issuer&#x2019;s performance or that of its designee.</font>

If a bankruptcy Event of Default with respect to the Issuer occurs and is continuing, then the entire principal amount of the Outstanding Notes together with all accrued and unpaid interest and premium, if any, will automatically become due immediately and payable without any declaration or other act on the part of the Trustee or any Holder of the Notes. Holders of Notes may not enforce the Indenture or the Notes except as provided in the Indenture. The Trustee is not obligated to enforce the Indenture or the Notes unless it has received indemnity as it reasonably requires. The Indenture permits, subject to certain limitations therein provided, Holders of a majority in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then Outstanding to direct the Trustee in its exercise of any trust or power. The Trustee may withhold from Holders of Notes notice of certain continuing defaults or Events of Default if it determines that withholding notice is not opposed to their interest.</font>

   <font>Floating Rate Note due 2029</font>

  <div style="text-align: center;">&#xa0;

  <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>1.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Interest</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">
   <font>Apple Inc. (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Issuer</font><font>&#x201d;) promises to pay interest on the principal amount of this Note at a floating rate per annum, reset quarterly on each Floating Rate Interest Payment Date, equal to Compounded SOFR plus 0.45%, as described below; provided, that in no event will the interest on this Note be less than zero. Cash interest on the Notes will accrue from November 9, 2026 or the most recent Floating Rate Interest Payment Date to which interest has been paid. Interest on this Note will be paid to, but excluding, the relevant Floating Rate Interest Payment Date. The Issuer will pay interest quarterly in arrears on each Floating Rate Interest Payment Date, commencing February 9, 2027, to Holders of record at the close of business on the immediately preceding Interest Record Date. If February 9, May 9, August 9 or November 9 of any year is not a Business Day then the next succeeding Business Day will be the applicable Floating Rate Interest Payment Date and interest on the Notes will be paid on such next succeeding Business Day (unless such next succeeding Business Day falls in the succeeding calendar month, in which case the applicable Floating Rate Interest Payment Date will be the Business Day immediately preceding such February 9, May 9, August 9 or November 9, and interest on the Notes will be paid on such immediately preceding Business Day). If the maturity date of the Notes is not a Business Day, the payment of principal of, and interest on, the Notes will be made on the next succeeding Business Day and no interest will accrue for the period from and after such maturity date.</font>
  </div>
  <div>&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>2.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Interest Rate Determination and Interest Calculation.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">
   <font>The &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">initial interest period</font><font>&#x201d; means the period from and including the settlement date of the Notes to, but excluding, the first Floating Rate Interest Payment Date. Thereafter, each &#x201c;interest period&#x201d; means the period from and including a Floating Rate Interest Payment Date to, but excluding, the immediately succeeding Floating Rate Interest Payment Date (such succeeding Floating Rate Interest Payment Date, the &#x201c;Latter Floating Rate Interest Payment Date&#x201d;); provided that the final interest period for the Notes will be the period from and including the Floating Rate Interest Payment Date immediately preceding the maturity date of the Notes to, but excluding, the maturity date. Interest on the Notes will be computed on the basis of the actual number of days elapsed over a 360-day year.</font>
  </div>
  <div>&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">
   <font>The interest rate for the initial interest period will be Compounded SOFR determined on February 5, 2027, plus 0.45%. Thereafter, the interest rate for any interest period will be Compounded SOFR, as determined on the applicable date that is the second U.S. Government Securities Business Day preceding such Floating Rate Interest Payment Date (the &#x201c;Interest Determination Date&#x201d;), plus a margin of 0.45%.</font>
  </div>
  <div>&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">35</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt;">
   <font>The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A., or its successor appointed by the Issuer, will act as calculation agent (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Calculation Agent</font><font>&#x201d;). The Issuer may change the Calculation Agent with respect to the Notes at any time without notice to the Holders. The interest rate and amount of interest to be paid on the Notes for each interest period will be determined by the Calculation Agent. All determinations made by the Calculation Agent shall, in the absence of manifest error, be conclusive for all purposes and binding on the Issuer and the Holders. So long as Compounded SOFR is required to be determined with respect to the Notes, there will at all times be a Calculation Agent. In the event that any then-acting Calculation Agent shall be unable or unwilling to act, or that such Calculation Agent shall fail to duly establish Compounded SOFR for any interest period, or that the Issuer proposes to remove such Calculation Agent, the Issuer will appoint another Calculation Agent.</font>
  </div>
  <div>&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">
   <font>The amount of interest accrued and payable on the Notes for each interest period will be equal to the product of (i) the outstanding principal amount of the Notes multiplied by (ii) the product of (a) the interest rate for the relevant interest period multiplied by (b) the quotient of the actual number of calendar days in such interest period divided by 360.</font>
  </div>
  <div>&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">
   <font>As used herein the following terms have the meanings assigned to them:</font>
  </div>
  <div>&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Compounded SOFR&#x201d; means, with respect to any interest period, the rate computed in accordance with the following formula set forth below (and the resulting percentage will be rounded, if necessary, to the nearest one hundred-thousandth of a percentage point (e.g., 9.753973% (or .09753973) being rounded down to 9.75397% (or .0975397) and 9.753978% (or .09753978) being rounded up to 9.75398% (or .0975398)):</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: center;">
   <img src="image3.jpg" style="width: 171.02pt; height: 40.51pt;">
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: center;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">where:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Start</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201d; is the SOFR Index value for the day that is two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the first date of the relevant interest period, which for the initial interest period shall be November 5, 2026 (which is two U.S. Government Securities Business Days before the scheduled settlement date of the issuance of the Notes);</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">End</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201d; is the SOFR Index value for the day that is two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the Latter Floating Rate Interest Payment Date relating to such interest </font><font>period; </font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">and</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;d</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">c</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201d; is the actual number of calendar days from (and including) SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Start</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> to (but excluding) SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">End</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> (the actual number of calendar days in the applicable Observation Period).</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">For purposes of determining Compounded SOFR, &#x201c;SOFR Index&#x201d; means, with respect to any U.S. Government Securities Business Day:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">36</div>

    <div style="float: left; width: 18.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(1)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">the SOFR Index value as published by the New York Federal Reserve as such index appears on the New York Federal Reserve&#x2019;s Website at 3:00 p.m. (New York time) on such U.S. Government Securities Business Day (the &#x201c;SOFR Determination Time&#x201d;); </font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: italic;">provided</font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> that:</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: -18pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 36pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 18.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(2)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">if a SOFR Index value does not so appear as specified in clause (1) above at the SOFR Determination Time, then:</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: -18pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 54pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 18.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(a)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">if a Benchmark Transition Event and its related Benchmark Replacement Date (each as defined below) have not occurred with respect to SOFR, then Compounded SOFR shall be the rate determined pursuant to the &#x201c;SOFR Index Unavailable&#x201d; provisions described below; or</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 54pt; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: -18pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 54pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 18.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(b)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">if a Benchmark Transition Event and its related Benchmark Replacement Date have occurred with respect to SOFR, then Compounded SOFR shall be the rate determined pursuant to the &#x201c;Effect of a Benchmark Transition Event&#x201d; provisions described below.</font>

  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 54pt; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;New York Federal Reserve&#x201d; means the Federal Reserve Bank of New York (or a successor administrator of the Secured Overnight Financing Rate).</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;New York Federal Reserve&#x2019;s Website&#x201d; means the website of the New York Federal Reserve, currently at http://www.newyorkfed.org, or any successor source.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Observation Period&#x201d; means, in respect of each interest period, the period from and including two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the first date of such relevant interest period to but excluding two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the Latter Floating Rate Interest Payment Date for such interest </font><font>period;</font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> provided that the first Observation Period shall be the period from and including two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the settlement date of the Notes to, but excluding, the two U.S. Government Securities Business Days preceding the first Floating Rate Interest Payment Date.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;Secured Overnight Financing Rate&#x201d; or &#x201c;SOFR&#x201d; means the daily secured overnight financing rate as provided by the New York Federal Reserve on the New York Federal Reserve&#x2019;s Website.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#x201c;U.S. Government Securities Business Day&#x201d; means any day except for a Saturday, Sunday or a day on which the Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association recommends that the fixed income departments of its members be closed for the entire day for purposes of trading in U.S. government securities.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>3.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>SOFR Index Unavailable.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">If a SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Start</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> or SOFR Index</font><sub style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">End</sub><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> is not published on the associated Interest Determination Date and a Benchmark Transition Event and its related Benchmark Replacement Date have not occurred with respect to the Secured Overnight Financing Rate, &#x201c;Compounded SOFR&#x201d; means, for the applicable interest period for which such index is not available, the rate of return on a daily compounded interest investment calculated in accordance with the formula for SOFR Averages, and definitions required for such formula, published on the New York Federal Reserve&#x2019;s Website at https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/treasury-repo-reference-rates-information. For the purposes of this provision, references in the SOFR Averages compounding formula and related definitions to &#x201c;calculation period&#x201d; shall be replaced with &#x201c;Observation Period&#x201d; and the words &#x201c;that is, 30-, 90-, or 180- calendar days&#x201d; shall be removed. If the daily Secured Overnight Financing Rate (&#x201c;SOFRi&#x201d;) does not so appear for any day &#x201c;i&#x201d; in the Observation Period, SOFRi for such day &#x201c;i&#x201d; shall be SOFR published in respect of the first preceding U.S. Government Securities Business Day for which the Secured Overnight Financing Rate was published on the New York Federal Reserve&#x2019;s Website.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">

     <font>4.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Effect of a Benchmark Transition Event.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>If the Issuer </font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">or its designee determines on or prior to the relevant Reference Time that a Benchmark Transition Event and its related Benchmark Replacement Date have occurred with respect to the then-current Benchmark, the Benchmark Replacement will replace the then-current Benchmark for all purposes relating to the Notes in respect of all determinations on such date and for all determinations on all subsequent dates. In connection with the implementation of a Benchmark Replacement, the Issuer or its designee will have the right to make Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes from time to time. Any determination, decision or election that may be made by the Issuer or its designee pursuant to this section, including a determination with respect to a tenor, rate or adjustment or of the occurrence or non-occurrence of an event, circumstance or date and any decision to take or refrain from taking any action or any selection:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(1) will be conclusive and binding absent manifest error;</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(2) if made by the Issuer, will be made in its sole discretion;</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(3) if made by the Issuer&#x2019;s designee, will be made after consultation with the Issuer, and such designee will not make any such determination, decision or election to which the Issuer objects; and</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 20pt;">
   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(4) notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the documentation relating to the Notes, shall become effective without consent from the Holders or any other party.</font>

   <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">None of the Trustee (as hereinafter defined), the Paying Agent or the Calculation Agent shall be under any obligation (i) to monitor, determine or verify the unavailability or cessation of SOFR or the SOFR Index (or any other Benchmark), or whether or when there has occurred, or to give notice to any other transaction party of the occurrence of, any Benchmark Transition Event or related Benchmark Replacement Date, (ii) to select, determine or designate any Benchmark Replacement, or other successor or replacement benchmark index, or whether any conditions to the designation of such a rate or index have been satisfied, (iii) to select, determine or designate any Benchmark Replacement Adjustment, or other modifier to any replacement or successor index, or (iv) to determine whether or what Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes are necessary or advisable, if any, in connection with any of the foregoing, including, but not limited to, adjustments as to any alternative spread thereon, the </font><font>Business Day </font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">convention, interest determination dates or any other relevant methodology applicable to such substitute or successor benchmark. In connection with the foregoing, each of the Trustee, the Paying Agent or the Calculation Agent shall be entitled to conclusively rely on any determinations made by the Issuer or its designee without independent investigation, and none will have any liability for actions taken at the Issuer&#x2019;s direction in connection therewith. None of the Trustee, the Paying Agent or the Calculation Agent shall be liable for any inability, failure or delay on its part to perform any of its duties set forth in the Indenture or this Note as a result of the unavailability of SOFR, the SOFR </font><font>Index</font><font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> or other applicable Benchmark Replacement, including as a result of any failure, inability, delay, error or inaccuracy on the part of any other transaction party in providing any direction, instruction, notice or information required or contemplated by the terms of the Indenture or this Note and reasonably required for the performance of such duties. None of the Trustee, the Paying Agent or the Calculation Agent shall be responsible or liable for the Issuer&#x2019;s actions or omissions or for those of its designee, or for any failure or delay in the performance by the Issuer or its designee, nor shall any of the Trustee, Paying Agent or Calculation Agent be under any obligation to oversee or monitor the Issuer&#x2019;s performance or that of its designee.</font>
