  <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>1.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Interest</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Apple Inc. (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Issuer</font><font>&#x201d;) promises to pay interest on the principal amount of this Note at the rate per annum described above. Cash interest on the Notes will accrue from November 9, 2026 or the most recent Interest Payment Date to which interest has been paid. Interest on this Note will be paid to, but excluding, the relevant Interest Payment Date. The Issuer will pay interest semi-annually in arrears on each Interest Payment Date, commencing May 9, 2027, to Holders of record at the close of business on the immediately preceding Interest Record Date; provided, that if an Interest Payment Date for this Note falls on a day that is not a Business Day, the Interest Payment Date shall be postponed to the next succeeding Business Day. Interest on the Notes will be computed on the basis of a 360-day year consisting of twelve 30-day months in a manner consistent with Rule 11620(b) of the FINRA Uniform Practice Code.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Issuer shall pay interest on overdue principal from time to time on demand at the rate borne by the Notes and on overdue installments of interest (without regard to any applicable grace periods) to the extent lawful.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>2.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Paying Agent and Security Registrar.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Initially, The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A. (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Trustee</font><font>&#x201d;) will act as Paying Agent and Security Registrar. The Issuer may change any Paying Agent and Security Registrar without notice to the Holders.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>3.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Indenture; Defined Terms.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>This Note is one of the 4.650% Notes due 2028 (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Notes</font><font>&#x201d;) issued under an indenture, dated as of November 1, 2024 (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Base Indenture</font><font>&#x201d;), by and between the Issuer and the Trustee, as supplemented by an Officer&#x2019;s Certificate, dated November 9, 2026, issued pursuant to Section 301 of the Indenture (together with the Base Indenture, the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Indenture</font><font>&#x201d;). This Note is a &#x201c;Security&#x201d; and the Notes are &#x201c;Securities&#x201d; under the Indenture.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>For purposes of this Note, unless otherwise defined herein, capitalized terms herein are used as defined in the Indenture. The terms of the Notes include those stated in the Indenture and those made part of the Indenture by reference to the Trust Indenture Act as in effect on the date on which the Indenture was qualified under the Trust Indenture Act. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, the Notes are subject to all such terms, and Holders of Notes are referred to the Indenture and the Trust Indenture Act for a statement of them.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">50</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>4.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Denominations; Transfer; Exchange.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Notes are in registered form, without coupons, in denominations of $2,000 and any integral multiple of $1,000 in excess thereof. A Holder shall register the transfer or exchange of Notes in accordance with the Indenture. The Issuer may require a Holder, among other things, to furnish appropriate endorsements and transfer documents and to pay certain transfer taxes or similar governmental charges payable in connection therewith as permitted by the Indenture. The Issuer need not issue, authenticate, register the transfer of or exchange any Notes or portions thereof for a period of fifteen (15) days before the mailing of a notice of redemption, nor need the Issuer register the transfer or exchange of any Note selected for redemption in whole or in part, except the unredeemed portion of any Note being redeemed in part.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>5.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Amendment; Supplement; Waiver.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Subject to certain exceptions, the Notes and the provisions of the Indenture relating to the Notes may be amended or supplemented and any existing default or Event of Default or compliance with certain provisions may be waived with the written consent of the Holders of at least a majority in aggregate principal amount of each series of Outstanding Securities (including the Notes) under the Indenture that is affected by such amendment, supplement or waiver (voting as a single class). Without notice to or consent of any Holder of the Notes, the parties thereto may amend or supplement the Indenture and the Notes to, among other things, cure any ambiguity, defect or inconsistency or comply with any requirements of the Commission in connection with the qualification of the Indenture under the Trust Indenture Act, or make any other change that does not adversely affect the interests of the Holders of the Notes in any material respect.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>6.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Redemption.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Prior to the maturity date of the Notes, the Issuer may, at its option, redeem any of the Notes, at any time in whole or from time to time in part, each at a redemption price as calculated by the Issuer (expressed as a percentage of principal amount and rounded to three decimal places), equal to the greater of:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>(i)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>100% of the principal amount of the Notes being redeemed; and</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>(ii)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>the sum of the present values of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest on the Notes being redeemed (assuming such Notes matured on their maturity date), exclusive of interest accrued to, but excluding, the date of redemption, discounted to the date of redemption on a semi-annual basis (assuming a 360-day year consisting of twelve 30-day months) at the applicable Treasury Rate (as defined below) plus 5 basis points, plus, in each case, accrued and unpaid interest on the principal amount being redeemed to, but excluding, the date of redemption.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Notwithstanding the foregoing, installments of interest on the Notes that are due and payable on interest payment dates falling on or prior to a redemption date will be payable on the interest payment date to the registered Holders as of the close of business on the relevant record date according to the Notes and the Indenture.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>&#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Treasury Rate</font><font>&#x201d; means, with respect to any redemption date, the yield determined by the Issuer in accordance with the following two paragraphs.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">51</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Treasury Rate shall be determined by the Issuer after 4:15 p.m., New York City time (or after such time as yields on U.S. government securities are posted daily by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System), on the third Business Day preceding the redemption date based upon the yield or yields for the most recent day that appear after such time on such day in the most recent statistical release published by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System designated as &#x201c;Selected Interest Rates (Daily) - H.15&#x201d; (or any successor designation or publication) (&#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">H.15</font><font>&#x201d;) under the caption &#x201c;U.S. government securities&#x2013;Treasury constant maturities&#x2013;Nominal&#x201d; (or any successor caption or heading). In determining the Treasury Rate, the Issuer shall select, as applicable: (1) the yield for the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the period from the redemption date to the maturity date (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Remaining Life</font><font>&#x201d;); or (2) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the Remaining Life, the two yields &#x2013; one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately shorter than and one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately longer than the Remaining Life &#x2013; and shall interpolate to the maturity date on a straight-line basis (using the actual number of days) using such yields and rounding the result to three decimal places; or (3) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 shorter than or longer than the Remaining Life, the yield for the single Treasury constant maturity on H.15 closest to the Remaining Life. For purposes of this paragraph, the applicable Treasury constant maturity or maturities on H.15 shall be deemed to have a maturity date equal to the relevant number of months or years, as applicable, of such Treasury constant maturity from the redemption date.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>If on the third Business Day preceding the redemption date H.15 or any successor designation or publication is no longer published, the Issuer shall calculate the Treasury Rate based on the rate per annum equal to the semi-annual equivalent yield to maturity at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the second Business Day preceding such redemption date of the United States Treasury security maturing on, or with a maturity that is closest to the maturity date. If there is no United States Treasury security maturing on the maturity date, but there are two or more United States Treasury securities with a maturity date equally distant from the maturity date, one with a maturity date preceding the maturity date and one with a maturity date following the maturity date, the Issuer shall select the United States Treasury security with a maturity date preceding the maturity date. If there are two or more United States Treasury securities maturing on the maturity date or two or more United States Treasury securities meeting the criteria of the preceding sentence, the Issuer shall select from among these two or more United States Treasury securities the United States Treasury security that is trading closest to par based upon the average of the bid and asked prices for such United States Treasury securities at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the applicable date. In determining the Treasury Rate in accordance with the terms of this paragraph, the semi-annual yield to maturity of the applicable United States Treasury security shall be based upon the average of the bid and asked prices (expressed as a percentage of principal amount) at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the applicable date, of such United States Treasury security, and rounded to three decimal places.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Issuer&#x2019;s actions and determinations in determining the redemption price shall be conclusive and binding for all purposes, absent manifest error.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The provisions of Article XI of the Indenture shall apply to any redemption of the Notes.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">52</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Notice of any redemption will be mailed or electronically delivered at least 10 days but not more than 60 days before the redemption date to each Holder of record of the Notes to be redeemed at its registered address. Notices of redemption may be conditioned upon the occurrence of one or more subsequent events specified in the notice. The notice of redemption for the Notes will state, among other things, the amount of Notes to be redeemed, the redemption date, the manner in which the redemption price will be calculated, the place or places that payments will be made upon presentation and surrender of the Notes to be redeemed and, if applicable, any condition to such redemption. Unless the Issuer defaults in the payment of the redemption price, interest will cease to accrue on any Notes that have been called for redemption at the redemption date. If less than all of the Notes of a series are to be redeemed, the Notes of such series to be redeemed will be selected according to DTC procedures, in the case of Notes represented by a Global Note, or by lot, in the case of Notes that are not represented by a Global Note.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>7.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Defaults and Remedies.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>If an Event of Default (other than certain bankruptcy Events of Default with respect to the Issuer) under the Indenture occurs with respect to the Notes and is continuing, then the Trustee may and, at the direction of the Holders of at least 33% in principal amount of the Outstanding Notes, shall by written notice, require the Issuer to repay immediately the entire principal amount of the Outstanding Notes, together with all accrued and unpaid interest and premium, if any. If a bankruptcy Event of Default with respect to the Issuer occurs and is continuing, then the entire principal amount of the Outstanding Notes together with all accrued and unpaid interest and premium, if any, will automatically become due immediately and payable without any declaration or other act on the part of the Trustee or any Holder of the Notes. Holders of Notes may not enforce the Indenture or the Notes except as provided in the Indenture. The Trustee is not obligated to enforce the Indenture or the Notes unless it has received indemnity as it reasonably requires. The Indenture permits, subject to certain limitations therein provided, Holders of a majority in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then Outstanding to direct the Trustee in its exercise of any trust or power. The Trustee may withhold from Holders of Notes notice of certain continuing defaults or Events of Default if it determines that withholding notice is not opposed to their interest.</font>

     <font>8.</font>

    <div>
     <font>Authentication.</font>

  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;

  <div style="text-align: center;">
   <font>(REVERSE OF NOTE)</font>

  <div style="text-align: center;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: center;">
   <font>APPLE INC.</font>
  </div>

  <div style="text-align: center;">
   <font>4.750% Note due 2029</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: center;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>1.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Interest</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Apple Inc. (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Issuer</font><font>&#x201d;) promises to pay interest on the principal amount of this Note at the rate per annum described above. Cash interest on the Notes will accrue from November 9, 2026 or the most recent Interest Payment Date to which interest has been paid. Interest on this Note will be paid to, but excluding, the relevant Interest Payment Date. The Issuer will pay interest semi-annually in arrears on each Interest Payment Date, commencing May 9, 2027, to Holders of record at the close of business on the immediately preceding Interest Record Date; provided, that if an Interest Payment Date for this Note falls on a day that is not a Business Day, the Interest Payment Date shall be postponed to the next succeeding Business Day. Interest on the Notes will be computed on the basis of a 360-day year consisting of twelve 30-day months in a manner consistent with Rule 11620(b) of the FINRA Uniform Practice Code.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Issuer shall pay interest on overdue principal from time to time on demand at the rate borne by the Notes and on overdue installments of interest (without regard to any applicable grace periods) to the extent lawful.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>2.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Paying Agent and Security Registrar.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Initially, The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A. (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Trustee</font><font>&#x201d;) will act as Paying Agent and Security Registrar. The Issuer may change any Paying Agent and Security Registrar without notice to the Holders.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>3.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Indenture; Defined Terms.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>This Note is one of the 4.750% Notes due 2029 (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Notes</font><font>&#x201d;) issued under an indenture, dated as of November 1, 2024 (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Base Indenture</font><font>&#x201d;), by and between the Issuer and the Trustee, as supplemented by an Officer&#x2019;s Certificate, dated November 9, 2026, issued pursuant to Section 301 of the Indenture (together with the Base Indenture, the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Indenture</font><font>&#x201d;). This Note is a &#x201c;Security&#x201d; and the Notes are &#x201c;Securities&#x201d; under the Indenture.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>For purposes of this Note, unless otherwise defined herein, capitalized terms herein are used as defined in the Indenture. The terms of the Notes include those stated in the Indenture and those made part of the Indenture by reference to the Trust Indenture Act as in effect on the date on which the Indenture was qualified under the Trust Indenture Act. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, the Notes are subject to all such terms, and Holders of Notes are referred to the Indenture and the Trust Indenture Act for a statement of them.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">61</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>4.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Denominations; Transfer; Exchange.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Notes are in registered form, without coupons, in denominations of $2,000 and any integral multiple of $1,000 in excess thereof. A Holder shall register the transfer or exchange of Notes in accordance with the Indenture. The Issuer may require a Holder, among other things, to furnish appropriate endorsements and transfer documents and to pay certain transfer taxes or similar governmental charges payable in connection therewith as permitted by the Indenture. The Issuer need not issue, authenticate, register the transfer of or exchange any Notes or portions thereof for a period of fifteen (15) days before the mailing of a notice of redemption, nor need the Issuer register the transfer or exchange of any Note selected for redemption in whole or in part, except the unredeemed portion of any Note being redeemed in part.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>5.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Amendment; Supplement; Waiver.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Subject to certain exceptions, the Notes and the provisions of the Indenture relating to the Notes may be amended or supplemented and any existing default or Event of Default or compliance with certain provisions may be waived with the written consent of the Holders of at least a majority in aggregate principal amount of each series of Outstanding Securities (including the Notes) under the Indenture that is affected by such amendment, supplement or waiver (voting as a single class). Without notice to or consent of any Holder of the Notes, the parties thereto may amend or supplement the Indenture and the Notes to, among other things, cure any ambiguity, defect or inconsistency or comply with any requirements of the Commission in connection with the qualification of the Indenture under the Trust Indenture Act, or make any other change that does not adversely affect the interests of the Holders of the Notes in any material respect.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>6.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Redemption.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Prior to October 9, 2029, the Issuer may, at its option, redeem any of the Notes, at any time in whole or from time to time in part, each at a redemption price as calculated by the Issuer (expressed as a percentage of principal amount and rounded to three decimal places), equal to the greater of:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>(i)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>100% of the principal amount of the Notes being redeemed; and</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>(ii)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>the sum of the present values of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest on the Notes being redeemed (assuming such Notes matured on October 9, 2029), exclusive of interest accrued to, but excluding, the date of redemption, discounted to the date of redemption on a semi-annual basis (assuming a 360-day year consisting of twelve 30-day months) at the applicable Treasury Rate (as defined below) plus 5 basis points, plus, in each case, accrued and unpaid interest on the principal amount being redeemed to, but excluding, the date of redemption.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>On or after October 9, 2029, the Issuer may, at its option, redeem any of the Notes, at any time in whole or from time to time in part, each at a redemption price equal to 100% of the principal amount of the Notes being redeemed, plus accrued and unpaid interest on the principal amount being redeemed to, but excluding, the date of redemption.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Notwithstanding the foregoing, installments of interest on the Notes that are due and payable on interest payment dates falling on or prior to a redemption date will be payable on the interest payment date to the registered Holders as of the close of business on the relevant record date according to the Notes and the Indenture.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">62</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>&#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Par Call Date</font><font>&#x201d; means October 9, 2029 (one month prior to the maturity date of the Notes).</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font> &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Treasury Rate</font><font>&#x201d; means, with respect to any redemption date, the yield determined by the Issuer in accordance with the following two paragraphs.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Treasury Rate shall be determined by the Issuer after 4:15 p.m., New York City time (or after such time as yields on U.S. government securities are posted daily by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System), on the third Business Day preceding the redemption date based upon the yield or yields for the most recent day that appear after such time on such day in the most recent statistical release published by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System designated as &#x201c;Selected Interest Rates (Daily) - H.15&#x201d; (or any successor designation or publication) (&#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">H.15</font><font>&#x201d;) under the caption &#x201c;U.S. government securities&#x2013;Treasury constant maturities&#x2013;Nominal&#x201d; (or any successor caption or heading). In determining the Treasury Rate, the Issuer shall select, as applicable: (1) the yield for the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the period from the redemption date to the Par Call Date (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Remaining Life</font><font>&#x201d;); or (2) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the Remaining Life, the two yields &#x2013; one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately shorter than and one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately longer than the Remaining Life &#x2013; and shall interpolate to the Par Call Date on a straight-line basis (using the actual number of days) using such yields and rounding the result to three decimal places; or (3) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 shorter than or longer than the Remaining Life, the yield for the single Treasury constant maturity on H.15 closest to the Remaining Life. For purposes of this paragraph, the applicable Treasury constant maturity or maturities on H.15 shall be deemed to have a maturity date equal to the relevant number of months or years, as applicable, of such Treasury constant maturity from the redemption date.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>If on the third Business Day preceding the redemption date H.15 or any successor designation or publication is no longer published, the Issuer shall calculate the Treasury Rate based on the rate per annum equal to the semi-annual equivalent yield to maturity at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the second Business Day preceding such redemption date of the United States Treasury security maturing on, or with a maturity that is closest to the Par Call Date. If there is no United States Treasury security maturing on the Par Call Date, but there are two or more United States Treasury securities with a maturity date equally distant from the Par Call Date, one with a maturity date preceding the Par Call Date and one with a maturity date following the Par Call Date, the Issuer shall select the United States Treasury security with a maturity date preceding the Par Call Date. If there are two or more United States Treasury securities maturing on the Par Call Date or two or more United States Treasury securities meeting the criteria of the preceding sentence, the Issuer shall select from among these two or more United States Treasury securities the United States Treasury security that is trading closest to par based upon the average of the bid and asked prices for such United States Treasury securities at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the applicable date. In determining the Treasury Rate in accordance with the terms of this paragraph, the semi-annual yield to maturity of the applicable United States Treasury security shall be based upon the average of the bid and asked prices (expressed as a percentage of principal amount) at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the applicable date, of such United States Treasury security, and rounded to three decimal places.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">63</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Issuer&#x2019;s actions and determinations in determining the redemption price shall be conclusive and binding for all purposes, absent manifest error.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The provisions of Article XI of the Indenture shall apply to any redemption of the Notes.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Notice of any redemption will be mailed or electronically delivered at least 10 days but not more than 60 days before the redemption date to each Holder of record of the Notes to be redeemed at its registered address. Notices of redemption may be conditioned upon the occurrence of one or more subsequent events specified in the notice. The notice of redemption for the Notes will state, among other things, the amount of Notes to be redeemed, the redemption date, the manner in which the redemption price will be calculated, the place or places that payments will be made upon presentation and surrender of the Notes to be redeemed and, if applicable, any condition to such redemption. Unless the Issuer defaults in the payment of the redemption price, interest will cease to accrue on any Notes that have been called for redemption at the redemption date. If less than all of the Notes of a series are to be redeemed, the Notes of such series to be redeemed will be selected according to DTC procedures, in the case of Notes represented by a Global Note, or by lot, in the case of Notes that are not represented by a Global Note.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>7.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Defaults and Remedies.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>If an Event of Default (other than certain bankruptcy Events of Default with respect to the Issuer) under the Indenture occurs with respect to the Notes and is continuing, then the Trustee may and, at the direction of the Holders of at least 33% in principal amount of the Outstanding Notes, shall by written notice, require the Issuer to repay immediately the entire principal amount of the Outstanding Notes, together with all accrued and unpaid interest and premium, if any. If a bankruptcy Event of Default with respect to the Issuer occurs and is continuing, then the entire principal amount of the Outstanding Notes together with all accrued and unpaid interest and premium, if any, will automatically become due immediately and payable without any declaration or other act on the part of the Trustee or any Holder of the Notes. Holders of Notes may not enforce the Indenture or the Notes except as provided in the Indenture. The Trustee is not obligated to enforce the Indenture or the Notes unless it has received indemnity as it reasonably requires. The Indenture permits, subject to certain limitations therein provided, Holders of a majority in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then Outstanding to direct the Trustee in its exercise of any trust or power. The Trustee may withhold from Holders of Notes notice of certain continuing defaults or Events of Default if it determines that withholding notice is not opposed to their interest.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;

    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>4.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Denominations; Transfer; Exchange.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Notes are in registered form, without coupons, in denominations of $2,000 and any integral multiple of $1,000 in excess thereof. A Holder shall register the transfer or exchange of Notes in accordance with the Indenture. The Issuer may require a Holder, among other things, to furnish appropriate endorsements and transfer documents and to pay certain transfer taxes or similar governmental charges payable in connection therewith as permitted by the Indenture. The Issuer need not issue, authenticate, register the transfer of or exchange any Notes or portions thereof for a period of fifteen (15) days before the mailing of a notice of redemption, nor need the Issuer register the transfer or exchange of any Note selected for redemption in whole or in part, except the unredeemed portion of any Note being redeemed in part.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>5.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Amendment; Supplement; Waiver.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Subject to certain exceptions, the Notes and the provisions of the Indenture relating to the Notes may be amended or supplemented and any existing default or Event of Default or compliance with certain provisions may be waived with the written consent of the Holders of at least a majority in aggregate principal amount of each series of Outstanding Securities (including the Notes) under the Indenture that is affected by such amendment, supplement or waiver (voting as a single class). Without notice to or consent of any Holder of the Notes, the parties thereto may amend or supplement the Indenture and the Notes to, among other things, cure any ambiguity, defect or inconsistency or comply with any requirements of the Commission in connection with the qualification of the Indenture under the Trust Indenture Act, or make any other change that does not adversely affect the interests of the Holders of the Notes in any material respect.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>6.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Redemption.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Prior to October 9, 2031, the Issuer may, at its option, redeem any of the Notes, at any time in whole or from time to time in part, each at a redemption price as calculated by the Issuer (expressed as a percentage of principal amount and rounded to three decimal places), equal to the greater of:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>(i)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>100% of the principal amount of the Notes being redeemed; and</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>(ii)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>the sum of the present values of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest on the Notes being redeemed (assuming such Notes matured on October 9, 2031), exclusive of interest accrued to, but excluding, the date of redemption, discounted to the date of redemption on a semi-annual basis (assuming a 360-day year consisting of twelve 30-day months) at the applicable Treasury Rate (as defined below) plus 10 basis points, plus, in each case, accrued and unpaid interest on the principal amount being redeemed to, but excluding, the date of redemption.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>On or after October 9, 2031, the Issuer may, at its option, redeem any of the Notes, at any time in whole or from time to time in part, each at a redemption price equal to 100% of the principal amount of the Notes being redeemed, plus accrued and unpaid interest on the principal amount being redeemed to, but excluding, the date of redemption.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Notwithstanding the foregoing, installments of interest on the Notes that are due and payable on interest payment dates falling on or prior to a redemption date will be payable on the interest payment date to the registered Holders as of the close of business on the relevant record date according to the Notes and the Indenture.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">73</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>&#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Par Call Date</font><font>&#x201d; means October 9, 2031 (one month prior to the maturity date of the Notes).</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>&#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Treasury Rate</font><font>&#x201d; means, with respect to any redemption date, the yield determined by the Issuer in accordance with the following two paragraphs.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Treasury Rate shall be determined by the Issuer after 4:15 p.m., New York City time (or after such time as yields on U.S. government securities are posted daily by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System), on the third Business Day preceding the redemption date based upon the yield or yields for the most recent day that appear after such time on such day in the most recent statistical release published by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System designated as &#x201c;Selected Interest Rates (Daily) - H.15&#x201d; (or any successor designation or publication) (&#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">H.15</font><font>&#x201d;) under the caption &#x201c;U.S. government securities&#x2013;Treasury constant maturities&#x2013;Nominal&#x201d; (or any successor caption or heading). In determining the Treasury Rate, the Issuer shall select, as applicable: (1) the yield for the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the period from the redemption date to the Par Call Date (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Remaining Life</font><font>&#x201d;); or (2) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the Remaining Life, the two yields &#x2013; one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately shorter than and one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately longer than the Remaining Life &#x2013; and shall interpolate to the Par Call Date on a straight-line basis (using the actual number of days) using such yields and rounding the result to three decimal places; or (3) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 shorter than or longer than the Remaining Life, the yield for the single Treasury constant maturity on H.15 closest to the Remaining Life. For purposes of this paragraph, the applicable Treasury constant maturity or maturities on H.15 shall be deemed to have a maturity date equal to the relevant number of months or years, as applicable, of such Treasury constant maturity from the redemption date.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>If on the third Business Day preceding the redemption date H.15 or any successor designation or publication is no longer published, the Issuer shall calculate the Treasury Rate based on the rate per annum equal to the semi-annual equivalent yield to maturity at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the second Business Day preceding such redemption date of the United States Treasury security maturing on, or with a maturity that is closest to the Par Call Date. If there is no United States Treasury security maturing on the Par Call Date, but there are two or more United States Treasury securities with a maturity date equally distant from the Par Call Date, one with a maturity date preceding the Par Call Date and one with a maturity date following the Par Call Date, the Issuer shall select the United States Treasury security with a maturity date preceding the Par Call Date. If there are two or more United States Treasury securities maturing on the Par Call Date or two or more United States Treasury securities meeting the criteria of the preceding sentence, the Issuer shall select from among these two or more United States Treasury securities the United States Treasury security that is trading closest to par based upon the average of the bid and asked prices for such United States Treasury securities at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the applicable date. In determining the Treasury Rate in accordance with the terms of this paragraph, the semi-annual yield to maturity of the applicable United States Treasury security shall be based upon the average of the bid and asked prices (expressed as a percentage of principal amount) at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the applicable date, of such United States Treasury security, and rounded to three decimal places.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">74</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Issuer&#x2019;s actions and determinations in determining the redemption price shall be conclusive and binding for all purposes, absent manifest error.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The provisions of Article XI of the Indenture shall apply to any redemption of the Notes.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Notice of any redemption will be mailed or electronically delivered at least 10 days but not more than 60 days before the redemption date to each Holder of record of the Notes to be redeemed at its registered address. Notices of redemption may be conditioned upon the occurrence of one or more subsequent events specified in the notice. The notice of redemption for the Notes will state, among other things, the amount of Notes to be redeemed, the redemption date, the manner in which the redemption price will be calculated, the place or places that payments will be made upon presentation and surrender of the Notes to be redeemed and, if applicable, any condition to such redemption. Unless the Issuer defaults in the payment of the redemption price, interest will cease to accrue on any Notes that have been called for redemption at the redemption date. If less than all of the Notes of a series are to be redeemed, the Notes of such series to be redeemed will be selected according to DTC procedures, in the case of Notes represented by a Global Note, or by lot, in the case of Notes that are not represented by a Global Note.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>7.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Defaults and Remedies.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>If an Event of Default (other than certain bankruptcy Events of Default with respect to the Issuer) under the Indenture occurs with respect to the Notes and is continuing, then the Trustee may and, at the direction of the Holders of at least 33% in principal amount of the Outstanding Notes, shall by written notice, require the Issuer to repay immediately the entire principal amount of the Outstanding Notes, together with all accrued and unpaid interest and premium, if any. If a bankruptcy Event of Default with respect to the Issuer occurs and is continuing, then the entire principal amount of the Outstanding Notes together with all accrued and unpaid interest and premium, if any, will automatically become due immediately and payable without any declaration or other act on the part of the Trustee or any Holder of the Notes. Holders of Notes may not enforce the Indenture or the Notes except as provided in the Indenture. The Trustee is not obligated to enforce the Indenture or the Notes unless it has received indemnity as it reasonably requires. The Indenture permits, subject to certain limitations therein provided, Holders of a majority in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then Outstanding to direct the Trustee in its exercise of any trust or power. The Trustee may withhold from Holders of Notes notice of certain continuing defaults or Events of Default if it determines that withholding notice is not opposed to their interest.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;

  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Treasury Rate shall be determined by the Issuer after 4:15 p.m., New York City time (or after such time as yields on U.S. government securities are posted daily by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System), on the third Business Day preceding the redemption date based upon the yield or yields for the most recent day that appear after such time on such day in the most recent statistical release published by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System designated as &#x201c;Selected Interest Rates (Daily) - H.15&#x201d; (or any successor designation or publication) (&#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">H.15</font><font>&#x201d;) under the caption &#x201c;U.S. government securities&#x2013;Treasury constant maturities&#x2013;Nominal&#x201d; (or any successor caption or heading). In determining the Treasury Rate, the Issuer shall select, as applicable: (1) the yield for the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the period from the redemption date to the Par Call Date (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Remaining Life</font><font>&#x201d;); or (2) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the Remaining Life, the two yields &#x2013; one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately shorter than and one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately longer than the Remaining Life &#x2013; and shall interpolate to the Par Call Date on a straight-line basis (using the actual number of days) using such yields and rounding the result to three decimal places; or (3) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 shorter than or longer than the Remaining Life, the yield for the single Treasury constant maturity on H.15 closest to the Remaining Life. For purposes of this paragraph, the applicable Treasury constant maturity or maturities on H.15 shall be deemed to have a maturity date equal to the relevant number of months or years, as applicable, of such Treasury constant maturity from the redemption date.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>If on the third Business Day preceding the redemption date H.15 or any successor designation or publication is no longer published, the Issuer shall calculate the Treasury Rate based on the rate per annum equal to the semi-annual equivalent yield to maturity at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the second Business Day preceding such redemption date of the United States Treasury security maturing on, or with a maturity that is closest to the Par Call Date. If there is no United States Treasury security maturing on the Par Call Date, but there are two or more United States Treasury securities with a maturity date equally distant from the Par Call Date, one with a maturity date preceding the Par Call Date and one with a maturity date following the Par Call Date, the Issuer shall select the United States Treasury security with a maturity date preceding the Par Call Date. If there are two or more United States Treasury securities maturing on the Par Call Date or two or more United States Treasury securities meeting the criteria of the preceding sentence, the Issuer shall select from among these two or more United States Treasury securities the United States Treasury security that is trading closest to par based upon the average of the bid and asked prices for such United States Treasury securities at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the applicable date. In determining the Treasury Rate in accordance with the terms of this paragraph, the semi-annual yield to maturity of the applicable United States Treasury security shall be based upon the average of the bid and asked prices (expressed as a percentage of principal amount) at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the applicable date, of such United States Treasury security, and rounded to three decimal places.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;

Notices of redemption may be conditioned upon the occurrence of one or more subsequent events specified in the notice. The notice of redemption for the Notes will state, among other things, the amount of Notes to be redeemed, the redemption date, the manner in which the redemption price will be calculated, the place or places that payments will be made upon presentation and surrender of the Notes to be redeemed and, if applicable, any condition to such redemption. Unless the Issuer defaults in the payment of the redemption price, interest will cease to accrue on any Notes that have been called for redemption at the redemption date. If less than all of the Notes of a series are to be redeemed, the Notes of such series to be redeemed will be selected according to DTC procedures, in the case of Notes represented by a Global Note, or by lot, in the case of Notes that are not represented by a Global Note.</font>

If a bankruptcy Event of Default with respect to the Issuer occurs and is continuing, then the entire principal amount of the Outstanding Notes together with all accrued and unpaid interest and premium, if any, will automatically become due immediately and payable without any declaration or other act on the part of the Trustee or any Holder of the Notes. Holders of Notes may not enforce the Indenture or the Notes except as provided in the Indenture. The Indenture permits, subject to certain limitations therein provided, Holders of a majority in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then Outstanding to direct the Trustee in its exercise of any trust or power.   <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>1.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Interest</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Apple Inc. (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Issuer</font><font>&#x201d;) promises to pay interest on the principal amount of this Note at the rate per annum described above. Cash interest on the Notes will accrue from November 9, 2026 or the most recent Interest Payment Date to which interest has been paid. Interest on this Note will be paid to, but excluding, the relevant Interest Payment Date. The Issuer will pay interest semi-annually in arrears on each Interest Payment Date, commencing May 9, 2027, to Holders of record at the close of business on the immediately preceding Interest Record Date; provided, that if an Interest Payment Date for this Note falls on a day that is not a Business Day, the Interest Payment Date shall be postponed to the next succeeding Business Day. Interest on the Notes will be computed on the basis of a 360-day year consisting of twelve 30-day months in a manner consistent with Rule 11620(b) of the FINRA Uniform Practice Code.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Issuer shall pay interest on overdue principal from time to time on demand at the rate borne by the Notes and on overdue installments of interest (without regard to any applicable grace periods) to the extent lawful.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">

   <font>Initially, The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A. (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Trustee</font><font>&#x201d;) will act as Paying Agent and Security Registrar. The Issuer may change any Paying Agent and Security Registrar without notice to the Holders.</font>

     <font>3.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Indenture; Defined Terms.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>This Note is one of the 5.350% Notes due 2036 (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Notes</font><font>&#x201d;) issued under an indenture, dated as of November 1, 2024 (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Base Indenture</font><font>&#x201d;), by and between the Issuer and the Trustee, as supplemented by an Officer&#x2019;s Certificate, dated November 9, 2026, issued pursuant to Section 301 of the Indenture (together with the Base Indenture, the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Indenture</font><font>&#x201d;). This Note is a &#x201c;Security&#x201d; and the Notes are &#x201c;Securities&#x201d; under the Indenture.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>For purposes of this Note, unless otherwise defined herein, capitalized terms herein are used as defined in the Indenture. The terms of the Notes include those stated in the Indenture and those made part of the Indenture by reference to the Trust Indenture Act as in effect on the date on which the Indenture was qualified under the Trust Indenture Act. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, the Notes are subject to all such terms, and Holders of Notes are referred to the Indenture and the Trust Indenture Act for a statement of them.</font>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">94</div>

     <font>4.</font>

    <div>
     <font>Denominations; Transfer; Exchange.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Notes are in registered form, without coupons, in denominations of $2,000 and any integral multiple of $1,000 in excess thereof. A Holder shall register the transfer or exchange of Notes in accordance with the Indenture. The Issuer may require a Holder, among other things, to furnish appropriate endorsements and transfer documents and to pay certain transfer taxes or similar governmental charges payable in connection therewith as permitted by the Indenture. The Issuer need not issue, authenticate, register the transfer of or exchange any Notes or portions thereof for a period of fifteen (15) days before the mailing of a notice of redemption, nor need the Issuer register the transfer or exchange of any Note selected for redemption in whole or in part, except the unredeemed portion of any Note being redeemed in part.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>5.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Amendment; Supplement; Waiver.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Subject to certain exceptions, the Notes and the provisions of the Indenture relating to the Notes may be amended or supplemented and any existing default or Event of Default or compliance with certain provisions may be waived with the written consent of the Holders of at least a majority in aggregate principal amount of each series of Outstanding Securities (including the Notes) under the Indenture that is affected by such amendment, supplement or waiver (voting as a single class). Without notice to or consent of any Holder of the Notes, the parties thereto may amend or supplement the Indenture and the Notes to, among other things, cure any ambiguity, defect or inconsistency or comply with any requirements of the Commission in connection with the qualification of the Indenture under the Trust Indenture Act, or make any other change that does not adversely affect the interests of the Holders of the Notes in any material respect.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>6.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Redemption.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Prior to August 9, 2036, the Issuer may, at its option, redeem any of the Notes, at any time in whole or from time to time in part, each at a redemption price as calculated by the Issuer (expressed as a percentage of principal amount and rounded to three decimal places), equal to the greater of:</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>(i)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>100% of the principal amount of the Notes being redeemed; and</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>(ii)</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>the sum of the present values of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest on the Notes being redeemed (assuming such Notes matured on August 9, 2036), exclusive of interest accrued to, but excluding, the date of redemption, discounted to the date of redemption on a semi-annual basis (assuming a 360-day year consisting of twelve 30-day months) at the applicable Treasury Rate (as defined below) plus 10 basis points, plus, in each case, accrued and unpaid interest on the principal amount being redeemed to, but excluding, the date of redemption.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>On or after August 9, 2036, the Issuer may, at its option, redeem any of the Notes, at any time in whole or from time to time in part, each at a redemption price equal to 100% of the principal amount of the Notes being redeemed, plus accrued and unpaid interest on the principal amount being redeemed to, but excluding, the date of redemption.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Notwithstanding the foregoing, installments of interest on the Notes that are due and payable on interest payment dates falling on or prior to a redemption date will be payable on the interest payment date to the registered Holders as of the close of business on the relevant record date according to the Notes and the Indenture.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">95</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>&#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Par Call Date</font><font>&#x201d; means August 9, 2036 (three months prior to the maturity date of the Notes).</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>&#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Treasury Rate</font><font>&#x201d; means, with respect to any redemption date, the yield determined by the Issuer in accordance with the following two paragraphs.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Treasury Rate shall be determined by the Issuer after 4:15 p.m., New York City time (or after such time as yields on U.S. government securities are posted daily by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System), on the third Business Day preceding the redemption date based upon the yield or yields for the most recent day that appear after such time on such day in the most recent statistical release published by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System designated as &#x201c;Selected Interest Rates (Daily) - H.15&#x201d; (or any successor designation or publication) (&#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">H.15</font><font>&#x201d;) under the caption &#x201c;U.S. government securities&#x2013;Treasury constant maturities&#x2013;Nominal&#x201d; (or any successor caption or heading). In determining the Treasury Rate, the Issuer shall select, as applicable: (1) the yield for the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the period from the redemption date to the Par Call Date (the &#x201c;</font><font style="font-weight: bold;">Remaining Life</font><font>&#x201d;); or (2) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 exactly equal to the Remaining Life, the two yields &#x2013; one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately shorter than and one yield corresponding to the Treasury constant maturity on H.15 immediately longer than the Remaining Life &#x2013; and shall interpolate to the Par Call Date on a straight-line basis (using the actual number of days) using such yields and rounding the result to three decimal places; or (3) if there is no such Treasury constant maturity on H.15 shorter than or longer than the Remaining Life, the yield for the single Treasury constant maturity on H.15 closest to the Remaining Life. For purposes of this paragraph, the applicable Treasury constant maturity or maturities on H.15 shall be deemed to have a maturity date equal to the relevant number of months or years, as applicable, of such Treasury constant maturity from the redemption date.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>If on the third Business Day preceding the redemption date H.15 or any successor designation or publication is no longer published, the Issuer shall calculate the Treasury Rate based on the rate per annum equal to the semi-annual equivalent yield to maturity at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the second Business Day preceding such redemption date of the United States Treasury security maturing on, or with a maturity that is closest to the Par Call Date. If there is no United States Treasury security maturing on the Par Call Date, but there are two or more United States Treasury securities with a maturity date equally distant from the Par Call Date, one with a maturity date preceding the Par Call Date and one with a maturity date following the Par Call Date, the Issuer shall select the United States Treasury security with a maturity date preceding the Par Call Date. If there are two or more United States Treasury securities maturing on the Par Call Date or two or more United States Treasury securities meeting the criteria of the preceding sentence, the Issuer shall select from among these two or more United States Treasury securities the United States Treasury security that is trading closest to par based upon the average of the bid and asked prices for such United States Treasury securities at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the applicable date. In determining the Treasury Rate in accordance with the terms of this paragraph, the semi-annual yield to maturity of the applicable United States Treasury security shall be based upon the average of the bid and asked prices (expressed as a percentage of principal amount) at 11:00 a.m., New York City time, on the applicable date, of such United States Treasury security, and rounded to three decimal places.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>

  <div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="display: none; text-align: center">96</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"></div>
</div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The Issuer&#x2019;s actions and determinations in determining the redemption price shall be conclusive and binding for all purposes, absent manifest error.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>The provisions of Article XI of the Indenture shall apply to any redemption of the Notes.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>Notice of any redemption will be mailed or electronically delivered at least 10 days but not more than 60 days before the redemption date to each Holder of record of the Notes to be redeemed at its registered address. Notices of redemption may be conditioned upon the occurrence of one or more subsequent events specified in the notice. The notice of redemption for the Notes will state, among other things, the amount of Notes to be redeemed, the redemption date, the manner in which the redemption price will be calculated, the place or places that payments will be made upon presentation and surrender of the Notes to be redeemed and, if applicable, any condition to such redemption. Unless the Issuer defaults in the payment of the redemption price, interest will cease to accrue on any Notes that have been called for redemption at the redemption date. If less than all of the Notes of a series are to be redeemed, the Notes of such series to be redeemed will be selected according to DTC procedures, in the case of Notes represented by a Global Note, or by lot, in the case of Notes that are not represented by a Global Note.</font>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 36.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <font>7.</font>
    </div>
    <div>
     <font>Defaults and Remedies.</font>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="text-align: justify; clear: both;">&#xa0;
  </div>
  <div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <font>If an Event of Default (other than certain bankruptcy Events of Default with respect to the Issuer) under the Indenture occurs with respect to the Notes and is continuing, then the Trustee may and, at the direction of the Holders of at least 33% in principal amount of the Outstanding Notes, shall by written notice, require the Issuer to repay immediately the entire principal amount of the Outstanding Notes, together with all accrued and unpaid interest and premium, if any. If a bankruptcy Event of Default with respect to the Issuer occurs and is continuing, then the entire principal amount of the Outstanding Notes together with all accrued and unpaid interest and premium, if any, will automatically become due immediately and payable without any declaration or other act on the part of the Trustee or any Holder of the Notes. Holders of Notes may not enforce the Indenture or the Notes except as provided in the Indenture. The Trustee is not obligated to enforce the Indenture or the Notes unless it has received indemnity as it reasonably requires. The Indenture permits, subject to certain limitations therein provided, Holders of a majority in aggregate principal amount of the Notes then Outstanding to direct the Trustee in its exercise of any trust or power. The Trustee may withhold from Holders of Notes notice of certain continuing defaults or Events of Default if it determines that withholding notice is not opposed to their interest.</font>
